biography.value:
Published alignment: LG/NG.

Description

The scales of this juvenile elegant dragon shine like polished silver, and its tail has a feathered appearance.

Defense

AC 26, touch 12, flat-footed 23 (+3 dex, +14 natural, -1 size)

hp 126 [192] (12d12+48)

mp 75

Fort +12, Ref +13, Will +12

DR 5/magic; Immune Holy, Paralysis, Sleep

Weakness Shadow

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +16 (2d6+7), 2 Claws +16 (1d8+5), 2 Wings +11 (1d6+2), Tail Slap +11 (1d8+7)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (40-ft. cone, 6d10 holy damage, Reflex DC 18 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Light Rays, MP Absorb, Paralyzing Breath

Special Abilities Hallowed Armor

Spells Known (FC CL 12th, Concentration +19)

At will - dancing light, detect magic, holy orb, mending, purify food and drink, message, read magic

1st (DC 18) - Cure, Dia, Light

2nd (DC 19) - Aid, Cure II, Dia II, Elemental Resistance, Grace, Heal, Light II, See Invisibility

3rd (DC 20) - Cura, Cure III, Dia III, Dispel, Haste, Light III, Lightra

4th (DC 21) - Diara, Esuna, Healara, Holy, Raise, Vanish

Statistics

Str 20, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 12, Wis 24, Cha 14

Base Atk +12; CMB +18; CMD 31 (35 vs. trip)

Feats Arcane Strike, Combat Casting, Improved Counterspell, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes

Skills Diplomacy +16, Fly +11, Knowledge (arcana, nobility) +15, Perception +21, Sense Motive +21, Spellcraft +15

Languages Common, Draconic

SQ dogmatic discordance

description.value: Good or evil creatures take a -2 penalty when making saving throws against a silver dragon's spells, spell-like abilities, supernatural abilities, breath weapon, and aura.

Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, the silver dragon grants allies an scared barrier. All allies gain the effect of Radiant Spikes, as the white magic spell. The allies must be within 30 feet of the silver dragon when it uses this ability to receive these bonuses. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, the silver dragon grants allies an scared barrier. All allies gain the effect of Radiant Spikes, as the white magic spell. The allies must be within 30 feet of the silver dragon when it uses this ability to receive these bonuses. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Transfer Hallowed Armor: protected to each protected ally. Use either the recipient's Retaliate or the grantor's retaliation roll, never both. The recipient copy uses this statblock's caster level; for an advanced grantor use its own retaliation action.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: As a standard action, a silver dragon fires 3 beams of holy energy at its foes, up to 30 feet away. Each ray requires a ranged touch attack (+14) to hit and deals 2d6 points of holy damage. The rays may be fired at the same or different targets, but all rays must be aimed at targets within 30 feet of each other and fired simultaneously. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
